# NanoScrape

> NanoScrape (Apify namespace: santamaria-automations) publishes 174 HTTP-only, Go-based web scraping actors on the Apify marketplace. Categories: job boards (89), business directories (15), e-commerce (13), marketplaces (9), enrichment (11), real-estate (6), social media (8), web tools (18), search & news (3), reviews (2). Every actor is billed pay-per-result on Apify (no monthly fee). Based in Switzerland.

## Key facts
- Runtime: Apify cloud, HTTP-only Go actors, datacenter proxies by default
- Pricing: pay-per-result, no monthly fee; Apify free tier $5/month
- Actor namespace on Apify: `santamaria-automations`
- Website: https://www.nanoscrape.com/
- Actor catalog (structured JSON): https://www.nanoscrape.com/search-index.json
- Sitemap index: https://www.nanoscrape.com/sitemap.xml
